max_tire.note: Mercedes said 37x12.5x18 mud-terrains would be available for production trucks, and concept photos showed 37-inch tires on beadlocks. Mercedes-Benz USA says larger tires don't need a speedometer recalibration. Check caliper clearance before going to 18-inch wheels

items.title: Brake booster vacuum hose
items.summary: Vacuum hose for the brake booster may collapse, increasing braking effort; covers 2017 G 550 and G 550 4×4²

items.title: Rear axle differential housing (G 63 4×4², second generation)
items.summary: Rear diff housing may crack and leak or break, causing loss of rear-wheel control; owners told not to drive until inspected

items.title: Rear axle differential housing (G 63 4×4², second generation)
items.summary: Further rear diff housing cracking campaign for 2022–2023 G 63 4×4²; do not drive until repaired

timeline.change: G 63 AMG 6×6 introduced. Its portal-axle running gear is the basis for the 4×4²; just over 100 sold, last delivery May 2015
G 500 4×4² goes into production after a positive reaction to the concept car; four-litre twin-turbo V8, KW dual-spring suspension
Sold in the US for MY2017 as the G 550 4×4² at $225,000 plus $925 destination; deliveries from early 2017
Mercedes-Maybach G 650 Landaulet inherits the portal axles; 99 built
Ordering closes ahead of the second-generation G; some US trucks are titled as 2018 models
Mercedes-AMG G 63 4×4² revives the idea on the new G, with portal axles and independent front suspension
Rear differential housing recalls (22V937, 23V851) on the new G 63 4×4²; check the VIN

identify.intro: Shops build 4×4² lookalikes from ordinary Gs, and some aftermarket portal-axle conversions are serious builds. Only a factory truck has the matching VIN.

items.head: VIN characters 4–8
items.body: Bring a Trailer's US 4×4²s decode in NHTSA's vPIC as WDCYC5FF… (2017) and WDCYC5FH… (2018; vPIC series 'G550 4x4'). A regular 2016–2018 G 550 reads WDCYC3KF… / WDCYC3KH….

items.head: Model year
items.body: The 10th character is H for 2017 and J for 2018. US trucks were sold as 2017 models, and some were titled as 2018s.

items.head: Track and tires
items.body: Factory trucks run 325/55R22 tires on 9.5x22 wheels, and the front track is about 9 in wider (rear about 10 in) than a standard G, with carbon-fibre arch extensions to cover it.

items.head: Suspension
items.body: Factory trucks have KW-developed dual-spring struts with adjustable damping at each corner, and a Comfort/Sport damper switch inside. Portal hubs without that suspension point to a conversion.

items.head: Window sticker and data card
items.body: Ask for the Monroney label and the Mercedes data card. The US MSRP was $225,000 before options.

breakover at maximum load; launch release quoted 47.4°

values.intro: US 4×4² prices have come down from their 2023–24 levels, though they still cost about twice as much as a regular late G 550.
values.note: Based on seven Bring a Trailer sales of 2017–2018 G 550 4×4²s from January 2025 to October 2026 ($97,500–154,000). In 2023–24 the same trucks made $148,500–222,000, including a 47-mile 2018 at $222,000. The second-generation range comes from 12 G 63 4×4² sales in 2025–26.
